We are looking for individuals who are comfortable working in an environment where processes are continuously evolving, and where technology including AI, is used to drive better outcomes. We need a delivery leader who deeply understands BPO and technical services, acting as a trusted advisor to our clients from the moment a deal closes through a successful go-live. You will architect their onboarding experience, translate their technical and business requirements into operational realities, and drive external projects with authority, high emotional intelligence, and discipline. Key Responsibilities Consultative Client Onboarding & Delivery Act as a Strategic Guide: Lead the end-to-end onboarding process for new client engagements. Leverage your understanding of Avanto's BPO and technical services to advise clients on best practices and steer them away from potential implementation pitfalls. Drive Kickoff & Alignment: Own the agenda and facilitate high-level external kickoff meetings. Ensure client executives and operational leaders are fully aligned on scope, technical requirements, workflows, and communication cadences. Manage Expectations & Scope: Act as the gatekeeper between the sales process and operational reality. Confidently manage client expectations to prevent scope creep during the onboarding phase. Technical & Operational Translation Bridge the Gap: Serve as the critical translator between the client's business needs and our internal operations and technical delivery teams. Validate Requirements: Ensure that all technical requirements, IT infrastructure needs, and outsourced operational workflows are thoroughly documented, understood by the client, and actionable for the Avanto team. Client Transition & Offboarding Manage Seamless Transitions: Architect structured transition and offboarding plans when client engagements evolve or conclude. Ensure Operational Readiness: Coordinate final knowledge transfer, documentation handoffs, and operational closure to guarantee a steady-state transition without disruption. Required Skills & Competencies Industry Acumen: Demonstrated ability to understand and speak confidently about BPO services, technical workflows, or IT infrastructure to both technical and non-technical external stakeholders. Consultative Polish: Exceptional external-facing presence. You must possess the emotional intelligence to navigate complex client dynamics, manage frustrations gracefully, and guide executives through operational change. Assertive Stakeholder Management: The ability to confidently set boundaries and guide client expectations while maintaining a premium service experience. Communication: Authoritative written and verbal communication. You command a room during client kickoffs and executive check-ins. Project Management Tools: Strong experience building out transparent client-facing project trackers in tools like Jira, Notion, or similar platforms. Experience leveraging automation or AI tools to improve workflows is preferred Experience & Qualifications Experience: 3–6 years of client-facing project management or implementation experience. Industry Background: Required experience working within a BPO, Managed Services Provider (MSP), or Technical Professional Services environment. Education: Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Operations, Project Management, or a related field. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Time-to-Value: Average time required to successfully onboard new clients and achieve operational readiness. Client Satisfaction (CSAT): Client feedback scores specifically related to the onboarding and implementation experience. Scope Fidelity: Minimization of out-of-scope requests or undocumented changes during the implementation phase. Implementation Quality: Successful transition of clients into steady-state operations with zero post-launch disruption. Salary: $1,500- 2,000 USD

title: Especialista Técnico SAP I
description:
No Grupo SBF, reunimos duas grandes forças do esporte no Brasil: a Centauro, maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina, e a Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no país.


Queremos ser referência em esporte no Brasil e construir um futuro em que cada experiência com o esporte inspire, motive e transforme.


E aí, que tal vestir essa camisa com a gente?


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Arquitetura e Governança de Soluções (Keep the Core Clean): Atuar como autoridade técnica e ponto focal para decisões de design em ambientes ABAP e SAP BTP. Garantir a integridade do sistema através da estratégia Keep the Core Clean, definindo padrões de arquitetura (In-app e Side-by-side) que assegurem a escalabilidade e a facilidade de futuras atualizações do ERP.
  • Liderança Técnica e Excelência em Engenharia : Liderar a squad técnica estabelecendo e zelando por padrões de alta performance, segurança e qualidade de código (Clean ABAP). Realizar Code Reviews críticos e auditorias técnicas para garantir que as entregas do time (interno ou terceirizado) estejam alinhadas às melhores práticas de desenvolvimento.
  • Inovação e Modernização do Ecossistema : Direcionar a adoção de tecnologias de ponta e novos modelos de programação, como SAP Fiori, RAP (Restful ABAP Programming Model) e CAP (Cloud Application Programming Model). Identificar oportunidades de inovação tecnológica que transformem processos de negócio em soluções digitais eficientes.
  • Interface Estratégica e Tradução de Negócio : Atuar como facilitador entre as áreas funcionais, Gerentes de Projetos e o time técnico. Traduzir requisitos de negócio complexos em especificações técnicas viáveis, garantindo que as expectativas dos stakeholders sejam atendidas com soluções tecnicamente sustentáveis.
  • Gestão do Ciclo de Vida e Mentoria : Supervisionar o ciclo de vida completo das soluções (do desenho técnico ao deploy e sustentação). Atuar como mentor técnico da equipe, promovendo a disseminação de conhecimento, resolvendo gargalos complexos e elevando o nível de senioridade técnica do time.
  • Ambiente Tecnológico e Desafio: Atuar em um ecossistema (Híbrido / Cloud) de alta criticidade, sendo o guardião da transição tecnológica de legados ABAP para modelos modernos no SAP S/4HANA. O escopo abrange desde o refinamento técnico de melhorias contínuas até a liderança técnica em projetos estruturantes de inovação e integração via SAP BTP.
  • Funcionais e Negócio : Parceria direta com consultores funcionais (MM, SD, FI, CO, etc.) e BPs para traduzir dores operacionais em arquiteturas técnicas robustas.
  • Desenvolvimentos e Projetos: Interface com Gerentes de Projeto e Funcionais para definição de cronogramas técnicos, estimativas de esforço e priorização de backlogs baseada em viabilidade e impacto.
  • Metas Estratégicas do Cargo : Modernização do Core: Atingir KPIs de redução de customizações \"Z\" tradicionais em favor de extensões Side-by-Side e otimização do consumo de serviços no SAP BTP para evitar custos excedentes.
  • Qualidade e Estabilidade : Redução do Lead Time de desenvolvimento e diminuição de incidentes em PRD causados por falhas de transporte ou performance.
  • Nível de Maturidade Técnica : Elevar a proficiência do time em tecnologias como RAP, CAP e Fiori através de programas de mentoria interna.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Ecossistema SAP: Experiência sólida e comprovada em projetos de alta complexidade, com protagonismo técnico. Domínio prático na arquitetura de extensibilidade via SAP BTP e integrações nativas em nuvem.
  • Domínio de Desenvolvimento Moderno: Vivência profunda em programação ABAP (Standard e OO) em versões 7.5+; Utilização do Eclipse (ADT) e CDS Views.
  • Experiência com Extensibilidade e Cloud: Experiência prática na construção de extensões e integrações utilizando SAP BTP (Business Technology Platform).
  • Histórico de Liderança Técnica: Experiência prévia atuando como referência técnica (Tech Lead), sendo responsável por arquitetura de software, revisão de código (Code Review) e mentoria de desenvolvedores menos experientes.
  • Vivência em Metodologias Ágeis: Experiência de atuação em ambientes dinâmicos utilizando Scrum ou Kanban.

title: Full Stack Engineer (Python/React/AI tools)
description:
About Us

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our engineering team builds agentic solutions that data and research teams utilize to transform petabytes of raw data into strategic intelligence. Our resulting product delivers accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers — ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies — depend on to drive high-stakes decisions.

We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture — recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years — emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.

What It’s Like to Work at YipitData

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting — it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.

  • Ownership That Matters: You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
  • Rapid Growth: We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles: Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
  • Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high — always with purpose and intention

About The Role

We’re looking for a seasoned, high-output engineer who can develop our rapidly growing agent platform for our Revenue organization. This individual will sit on our Infrastructure team that builds AI-native solutions used by the entire company to find, convert, and better enable customers with the products we launch. The ideal candidate possesses 3+ years of architecting and developing full-stack applications, proficient data analytics skills, strong interest in agentic workflows, and 5+ years working on applications or codebases built with Python, Databricks, React/JavaScript/TypeScript, and AWS.

You’ll be responsible for production-grade systems that our customers and internal teams depend on daily. That means being responsive, reliable, and an excellent communicator — both when things are going well and especially when they’re not.

The ideal candidate treats AI coding tools as core infrastructure for how they work — not a novelty. You’ve shipped full-stack applications, you’re comfortable navigating ambiguity, and you are customer-obsessed in your approach to improving software.

As a Senior Software Engineer, You Will

  • Own features and systems end-to-end across multiple product surfaces — architecture, implementation, deployment, and iteration
  • Architect and deliver solutions for our Revenue, Revenue Operations, and Business Development teams – including data tools, applications, and agentic orchestrators
  • Serve as a subject matter expert across the whole stack, and report directly to the Chief Architect, who will provide hands-on mentorship in cutting‑edge AI-native development, big data analytics, and cloud infrastructure.
  • Collaborate closely with the Revenue organization, discovering opportunities, projects, and areas to revamp critical business processes with AI
  • Drive initiatives across teams — you’re not waiting for a PM to write a spec; you’re in the room shaping what gets built and why
  • Leverage AI tools like Claude Code, Cursor, Codex to improve personal productivity, ship trustworthy solutions faster through harness engineering, code quality, and documentation.
  • Produce clear documentation: create playbooks, docs, and training materials to institutionalize best practices.

You Are Likely To Succeed If

  • You have 5+ years of hands-on software development experience with a proven track record of shipping customer-facing applications — and the impact to show for it
  • You are stack-flexible: comfortable working across Python, TypeScript/React, and cloud infrastructure (AWS, Databricks). You learn new tools fast and don’t let unfamiliar tech slow you down
  • You have an AI-accelerated workflow — you actively use AI coding tools to ship faster, not as an experiment, but as how you work every day
  • You thrive in ambiguity — you can take a vague business problem, break it down, and deliver a working solution without heavy-handed direction
  • You are a strong communicator who can work directly with non-technical stakeholders, translate between business needs and engineering tradeoffs, and drive alignment
  • You are responsive and reliable — you take ownership of production systems and communicate proactively, especially under pressure
  • You have a bias toward action and ownership — you see a problem, you fix it; you see an opportunity, you ship it
  • You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, STEM, or a related technical discipline
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher)

What We Offer:

  • Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings.
  • Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities
  • We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more!
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust.
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package


Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.


We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.



Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Médico Endocrinologista
description:
*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO ENDOCRINOLOGISTA NA TELADOC HEALTH\"


Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!


A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicas e Médicos Especialistas em Endocrinologia! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.


*SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: *


A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.


*O QUE PROCURAMOS: *


Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na modalidade de consultas de especialidade em Endocrinologia , de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos;


DESCRIÇÃO DAS ATIVIDADES:



  • Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Endocrinologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.


  • Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endocrinológicos .


  • Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de conduzir anamnese virtual para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de risco e gravidade em Endocrinologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.


  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.


  • Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.


  • Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças Endocrinológicas .


  • Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.


  • Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.


  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.


  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca dos principais problemas de saúde em Endocrinologia.


  • Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.


  • Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.


  • Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.


  • Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.


  • Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.


  • Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.


  • Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.


REQUISITOS


Formação Acadêmica:

  • Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA
  • RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO EM ENDOCRINOLOGIA, concluída ou em andamento.


Certificações:

  • Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
  • Certificado de Título de Especialista - RQE (emitido pelo Conselho respectivo) em Endocrinologia, ou comprovante de matrícula em Residência, Pós Graduação, Especialização em Endocrinologia.
  • Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil).


Experiência:

Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Endocrinologia , sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde;


Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:

Prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endócrinos e metabólicos..


Competências Comportamentais:

Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.


Outros Requisitos Importantes:

Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.

title: Virtual Executive Assistant – Family Owned Business Group
description:
Summary

We are a family-owned business group overseeing a diversified portfolio of ventures across healthcare (medical practices), luxury travel, and Broadway / live entertainment production .

Our organization supports multiple senior executives who operate at the intersection of medicine, entrepreneurship, real estate, travel, and the performing arts . We are seeking a highly proactive, detail-oriented Virtual Executive Assistant to provide executive-level administrative and operational support across the group and help streamline day-to-day execution as our businesses continue to grow.


This is a unique opportunity to work closely with leadership across multiple industries , gaining exposure to complex operations, high-level decision-making, and creative as well as clinical environments.


Responsibilities

  • Manage and optimize executive calendars across multiple businesses, including coordinating meetings across time zones and balancing competing priorities
  • Serve as a primary communication liaison , screening and prioritizing emails, calls, and messages to ensure timely and appropriate responses
  • Coordinate travel arrangements including flights, accommodations, ground transportation, and detailed itineraries for business and personal travel
  • Prepare meeting materials , agendas, briefing notes, and follow-up summaries to ensure action items are tracked and completed
  • Conduct research on vendors, partners, venues, travel options, market opportunities, and industry trends to support executive decision-making
  • Manage relationships with vendors and external service providers , including medical offices, travel partners, production vendors, accountants, and legal teams
  • Organize and maintain digital filing systems across multiple entities, ensuring documents are secure, accessible, and well categorized
  • Assist with special projects , including event coordination, content creation, process documentation, operational improvements, and cross-business initiatives
  • Handle personal administrative tasks as needed to support executive productivity and work-life balance

Qualifications

  • 2–5 years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Virtual Assistant, or similar high-level administrative role supporting senior leaders
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to represent executives professionally across industries
  • Highly resourceful and high-agency , with a demonstrated ability to anticipate needs and solve problems independently
  • Advanced proficiency with productivity tools including Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets) , Zapier, Zoom, and project management platforms
  • Strong organizational skills with experience managing complex schedules and competing priorities
  • Proven track record of maintaining strict confidentiality and exercising sound judgment with sensitive information
  • Reliable high-speed internet and a dedicated home office setup
  • Availability to work during overlapping U.S. Eastern Time hours

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting founders, physicians, or executives across multiple businesses
  • Familiarity with CRM systems, expense management, invoicing, and basic bookkeeping
  • Experience coordinating events, travel, or live productions
  • Comfort working in both clinical / professional and creative / entertainment environments
  • Bilingual capabilities (Spanish is a plus but not required)
  • Experience with Notion, Hubspot and Zapier

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation commensurate with experience
  • Opportunity to work directly with senior leadership across healthcare, luxury travel, and Broadway / live entertainment
  • Exposure to a diversified business portfolio , not a single company role
  • Flexible, remote-first work environment with an emphasis on results over hours
  • Long-term growth potential for the right candidate who becomes a trusted operational partner

Assessorias, bancos e corretoras costumam bater metas nos clientes, enquanto deveriam bater as metas dos clientes.


Na contra-mão desse modelo, repleto de conflito de interesse, nasce o Grupo Capital, uma organização formada por pessoas que colocam seus clientes verdadeiramente em primeiro lugar.


Além de acesso às melhores soluções do mercado e um método exclusivo, validado por mais de 4 mil clientes, somos associados à Planejar, instituição responsável pelo CFP® no Brasil.

A evolução da sua carreira é prioridade! Por isso você terá acesso à ferramentas, especialistas certificados, mentores e um programa estruturado de partnership, para que você possa se tornar sócio do Grupo Capital.


Durante o seu onboarding você aprenderá tudo o que precisa sobre a metodologia exclusiva de planejamento financeiro e patrimonial e as habilidades técnicas e comportamentais, sempre envolvendo estudos de caso reais e prática.

Responsabilidades:

  • Realizar as vendas consultivas necessárias para que os clientes alcancem seus objetivos;
  • Aconselhar de forma adequada os recursos financeiros dos clientes. 


Pré-requisitos:

  • Proatividade orientada a resultados;

  • Comunicação clara, escuta ativa, carisma e simpatia;

  • Carteira ativa de clientes ou relacionamentos alta renda que possibilitem a construção de uma.


Diferencial:


  • Certificação CFP®, CEA, CNPI, CGA, AAI, SUSEP ou pós-graduação em áreas correlatas.


Você terá:

  • Treinamentos exclusivos;

  • Flexibilidade de horário e liberdade geográfica;
  • Oportunidade de desenvolver novos projetos/ produtos junto ao Grupo Capital;
  • Ambiente amigável, colaborativo e inspirador;
  • Suporte de backoffice e equipe de sucesso do cliente.

title: Clinical Study Manager
description:
Job Summary

The Clinical Study Manager (CSM) will be part of the Clinical Operations Department, which is responsible for planning, executing, managing and closing studies associated with the company clinical development plans. The CSM is a proven leader in clinical development with study management experience in the pharmaceutical or device industry. The CSM provides leadership and support to members of the multidisciplinary program teams, internally and externally, and can successfully thrive in a virtual clinical model. The CSM reports to the Senior Director of Clinical Operations and may be based at Liquidia’s headquarters in Research Triangle Park, North Carolina, or remote.


Specific Duties, Activities, and Responsibilities

  • Act as a patient advocate throughout the clinical development project lifecycle, with a mindset to minimize patient and site burden when participating in clinical trials.
  • Understand and support trial milestones including site identification and assessment, patient/subject recruitment, Key Opinion Leader (KOL) and Steering Committee development, and medical affairs support as required.
  • Coordinate internally with Medical and Quality Assurance to identify risks to clinical trial projects.
  • Participates in the development of study timelines, in coordination with the internal study team and external partners. Manages the trial according to agreed timelines.
  • Develop Requests for Proposals for vendors (CRO, Bioanalytical Labs, Central Safety Labs, Data Management groups, etc.) required to support clinical studies.
  • Assist or lead the vetting of vendors and sites for study participation.
  • In collaboration with Program Leaders, lead the development and updates of study specific protocols, consent forms, and other trial related materials (e.g., Study Monitoring Plan, Data Management Plans, CRFs, site training materials, Advertising Materials, etc.) as required.
  • Oversee the work of CROs and other vendors (Central Labs, Clinical Supply Distributors, etc.) as assigned to clinical trials.
  • Identifies potential risks to timelines, budgets, and quality, and participates in establishing and overseeing mitigation strategies with the internal team members and external partners, as applicable.
  • Manage and track clinical trial budgets to include forecasting, review, and approval of vendor and site payments. The CSM is also responsible for notifying management of anticipated change orders and/or budget adjustments proactively
  • Assumes primary accountability for assigned clinical trial execution according to protocol requirements, trial plans, company SOPs, ICH-GCP, FDA regulations, and applicable regulations in other regions.
  • Collaboratively work with the project team and other CRO/vendor resources and timelines associated with all study activities, including CRO/investigator agreements, central IRBs, database development and maintenance, monitoring strategy, QA audit plan, and coordination of Clinical Safety Review Teams when applicable.
  • Supports material planning and management to ensure appropriate execution of the clinical projects, including but not limited to distribution of documents, forms, supplies, equipment, and investigational product.
  • Reviews reports from study data systems which show progress of data collection, source document verification, and query resolution. Reports untimely data entry to Program lead.
  • Collaborates with Program Lead and medical monitor to ensure adverse event review and coding review occur on the timelines detailed in study plans.
  • Assists with review of study data reports during the cleaning phase of a study (i.e. prior to interim analysis or database lock) and aligns with team on any issues needing escalation.
  • Ensure the Trial Master File (TMF) is maintained and up to date and all documents are accounted for by completion of clinical study report.
  • Generate compelling periodic trial Newsletters to communicate important trial aspects to trial sites.
  • Ensure the development and maintenance of trial-specific tracking systems to enable proper study management and monitoring activities, as required
  • Work with the Senior Director of Clinical Operations, or similar to ensure that internal program team members are trained appropriately on study conduct
  • Serve as a liaison between external partners and internal team to ensure program specific information and ongoing updates are proactively communicated
  • Participates in the development, review, and implementation of departmental SOPs, processes, and initiatives.
  • Attend off-site meetings and conferences, as needed.
  • Mentorship of junior colleagues in Clinical Operations and other departments in areas of oversight to foster development and expansion of junior colleague skill sets.


Education and Experience

  • Bachelors with a minimum of five years of experience in clinical research, with at least two years of clinical project/study management.
  • Experience qualifying & managing external vendors (e.g. CRO, Call Center, Central labs, etc.).
  • Experience managing clinical project team personnel.
  • Experience leading operational teams through the start-up, study conduct, data management, and report writing of clinical studies.
  • Experience liaising cross-functional teams internally and with external partners to align on program expectations.
  • Experience reviewing and editing protocols and clinical study reports.
  • Demonstrates knowledge of Good Clinical Practices and all applicable US regulations governing clinical research, as well as working knowledge of the FDA submission process.
  • Experience in Global clinical studies and country/region specific regulations governing clinical research outside of the US.
  • Excellent organization and communication skills, including experience dealing with decision makers such as physicians and IRB members.
  • Demonstrates problem-solving and interpersonal skills.Must have a ‘can-do’ attitude and a strong desire to take ownership of many different projects.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple timelines, while maintaining the team focus.
  • Demonstrated ability to exercise judgment and determine appropriate action to a variety of problems of varying complexity.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple deadlines.


Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Strong desire to join a small company and work in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to work with remote teams and to negotiate with external providers.
  • Must be detail oriented, highly organized, reliable, and accurate.
  • Must be a motivated self-starter, adaptable, and capable of working within a matrix environment.
  • Must display sound judgment and discretion as well as problem solving abilities especially within a team environment.
  • Experience with tools and systems for managing clinical rials (CTMS, TMF, EDC, ePRO database, Microsoft suite, etc.).
  • .
  • Compelling interpersonal verbal, written and presentation skills in communication with internal and external customers.
  • Must have the ability to accommodate international and domestic travel up to 30% at the request of the business.
  • Must be fluent in English

title: Risk Management Officer
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.


Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.


As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement and maintain a comprehensive risk management framework, covering credit, market, liquidity, operational, and technology risks.
  • Conduct prudential and capital risk assessments, including stress testing, scenario analysis, and capital adequacy evaluations.
  • Prepare and support regulatory disclosures required for virtual asset service providers (VASPs) and financial institutions.
  • Oversee Margin-Account Operations, including;
  • Development of policies governing margin lending and virtual asset collateral
  • Setting and reviewing maximum loan-to-value (LTV) ratios and haircut levels
  • Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons and counterparty exposures
  • Ensuring compliance with client/institutional limits and capital requirements
  • Net-worth monitoring;
  • Review and monitor risk indicators across business functions, escalating material breaches or deviations to senior management and the Board.
  • Maintain independence from commercial and trading lines while ensuring collaboration with Compliance, Finance, and Operations.
  • Liaise with internal and external auditors, regulators, and governance committees on risk management and capital matters.
  • Support a risk-aware culture through training, communication, and continuous improvement of risk methodologies.
  • Deep practical knowledge in CMN Res. 4557/17 regarding the risk management structure, the financial structure and the information disclosure policy management.


Requirements:

  • Legally resident in Brazil.
  • Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in financial or prudential risk management, preferably within financial institutions, fintechs, or crypto/virtual asset firms.
  • Demonstrated independence from commercial functions and ability to operate as a second-line or independent control function.
  • Strong knowledge of Central Bank of Brazil risk management regulations, capital adequacy standards, and VASP disclosure requirements.
  • Expertise in market and liquidity risk frameworks, stress testing, and margin-account operations involving virtual assets.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field; postgraduate qualification preferred.
  • Strong quantitative, analytical, and communication skills; fluency in Portuguese and English .
  • Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors , including:
  • not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
  • unblemished reputation;
  • knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
  • technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.
  • not having been previously rejected or investigated by the Central Bank of Brazil within the past three years for submitting false, omitted, or inconsistent information in any authorization request

This is a high-impact role with real ownership across content, distribution, and community.

title: Senior Salesforce Developer
description:
Senior Salesforce Developer

Brazil


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Senior Salesforce Developer with Data Cloud experience to support a strategic initiative focused on reducing customer churn by integrating and enriching customer data across multiple platforms. This role will work closely with the Salesforce Architect, data engineering teams, and cross-functional partners to ingest, unify, and expose data within Salesforce CRM and Salesforce Data 360 (Data Cloud).

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Lead end-to-end ingestion and mapping of customer data from Salesforce CRM, Siebel, Azure/Microsoft Fabric, Oracle, and churn model outputs into Salesforce Data 360;
  • Design, build, and maintain identity and account unification rules to produce accurate customer matching and golden records;
  • Create scalable, repeatable pipelines for ingestion, transformation, mapping, and controlled promotion across environments (including Data 360 data kits);
  • Enrich Salesforce CRM records with Data 360 attributes and analytics/model insights (e.g., churn) using related lists, dynamic related lists, and custom UI components;
  • Support CRM data strategy during the Siebel-to-Salesforce migration, prioritizing Salesforce CRM as the system of engagement as adoption increases;
  • Develop and support APIs and integration services for secure internal consumption of Data 360 and CRM data; partner with architecture/engineering on integration patterns and implement ETL when native connectors don’t meet requirements;
  • Monitor and optimize Data 360 credit consumption to balance cost, performance, and SLAs;
  • Enable business teams to use enriched customer data for segmentation, activation, and analytics use cases;
  • Document processes, standards, and runbooks; contribute to shared enablement resources to drive adoption and operational continuity.

Essential Skills

  • Experience with Salesforce development;
  • Strong proficiency in: Apex, SOQL/SOSL, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Salesforce core data model, Salesforce APIs (REST/SOAP/Bulk), and integration design patterns;
  • Hands-on experience with Data ingestion and harmonization, Identity resolution and unification rules, Data kits and environment promotion, Large-scale data processing;
  • Experience connecting Salesforce Data Cloud/Data 360 to external systems (Azure/Microsoft Fabric, Oracle, Siebel, or similar), including when to use native connectors vs. custom integrations;
  • Experience with ETL processes and/or tools (e.g., Informatica, MuleSoft, Talend, Databricks);
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams;
  • Strong technical communication skills, able to translate complex concepts for architects, engineers, business users, and leadership;
  • Advanced English to be in contact with customer representative on a daily basis.

Highly Desirable Skills

  • Experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud, especially data activation and segmentation;
  • Experience with Siebel CRM integration and/or data migration;
  • Knowledge of telecom customer data, churn analytics, or Customer 360 implementations;
  • Familiarity with Azure data engineering and Microsoft Fabric connector limitations;
  • Understanding of scalable deployment pipelines and DevOps tooling (Git, CI/CD).

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

description:
Role Overview:

As our Marketing AI Agent Builder, you will be the lead architect for our \"agentic\" marketing stack. Your goal is to move beyond simple automation (if-this-then-that) toward autonomous systems that reason through marketing data, execute multi-channel campaigns, and self-correct based on performance. This is a \"Builder\" role—part Engineer, part Strategist, part Data Scientist. This is a remote role with the option to work anywhere in NA.

Core Responsibilities:

• Intelligent Research & Segmentation: Deploy agents to crawl the web for intent signals (hiring changes, funding, news) to dynamically update ICP segments and enrich CRM records in real-time.

• Autonomous Campaign Management: Build agents that independently monitor live campaigns (Search, Social, Email) and autonomously reallocate budgets or pause underperforming creatives based on real-time ROI.

• Dynamic Lead Nurturing: Design agents that use Natural Language Processing (NLP) to \"read\" prospect behavior and trigger personalized, multi-step nurture sequences without manual intervention.

• Performance & Guardrails: Establish \"human-in-the-loop\" protocols and evaluation frameworks to ensure agent outputs align with brand voice and security standards.

• System Orchestration: Connect AI agents to our core stack—including HubSpot/Salesforce, 6sense, and Google Analytics—ensuring seamless data flow and automated write-backs to the CRM.

Qualifications & Skills:

• Experience: 2–4 years in Growth Engineering, ideally with experience scaling a mid-market SaaS revenue engine.

• AI Tooling: Proficiency with agent orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI) or low-code builder platforms (e.g., Claude CoWork, CodeX)

• Agent Orchestration: Experience with low-code/no-code platforms (e.g., Clay, Zapier Central, Make.com) or code-based frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI).

• Prompt Engineering: Ability to design complex \"reasoning loops\" that prevent hallucinations and ensure professional, brand-aligned output.

• Data Savvy: Comfortable working with JSON, APIs, and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) to feed agents the right context from your company’s internal knowledge base.

• Marketing Expertise: Knowledge of B2B buyer journeys, attribution models, and demand generation tactics.

title: Senior Backend (Node.js) Engineer

Having recently closed our Series A funding round, XILO is growing rapidly and seeking talented individuals who want to do career-defining work in a mission-driven startup that’s at the forefront of AI innovation.


About The Role

As a Senior Backend Engineer , you’ll be designing and architecting scalable solutions , creating robust APIs, and building new microservices from the ground up —while also improving and optimizing our existing systems. This isn’t just another engineering role. We’re solving real, painful inefficiencies in the insurance space – problems so frustrating that prospects have nearly teared up during sales calls, realizing how much time and effort we could save them. What we’re building isn’t just an upgrade – it’s a fundamental shift in how agencies operate .


What You’ll Do:

  • Architect and develop scalable TypeScript microservices powering XILO’s platform.
  • You’ll have the opportunity to work where your strengths shine and contribute to:
  • AI Agents – Automating complex decision-making and workflows
  • OCR & Document Processing – Extracting, structuring, and analyzing key insights from insurance documents
  • Intelligent Data Mapping – Aggregating and linking all relevant data into a centralized, dynamic user profile
  • Advanced Insurance Operations & CRM – The AI-powered backbone of agencies, seamlessly tracking, managing, and integrating customer data across tools and workflows while replacing outdated, manual processes
  • Forms Builder & Smart Data Entry – A Typeform-like system built for insurance, enabling error-proof, collaborative submissions – fill once, apply everywhere
  • Optimize system performance, reliability, and scalability.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (product, frontend, data science) to deliver seamless integrations.
  • Mentor and guide junior engineers, fostering a collaborative and growth-oriented team culture.
  • Implement best practices for API security, data privacy, and maintainability.

This role sits at the center of customer truth. When done well, it improves customer trust, reduces mistakes, helps the support team move faster, and makes AI genuinely useful.

Please apply with your resume and a short note answering these 3 questions:

  • Tell us about a knowledge base, FAQ, or support system you improved.

• Maintain relevant certifications (IFS or equivalent ERP modules).

• Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities.

• Experience with project management and collaboration tools.

• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office.

• Availability to travel.

• Legally authorized to work in Brazil.


What We Offer

• Competitive salary and benefits package.

• Career growth opportunities with certifications and professional development.

• A collaborative and international work environment.

• Involvement in high-impact global supply chain transformation projects.


Why Hoist?

If you are looking for an opportunity to lead impactful supply chain transformations and grow your career in a dynamic and global environment, Hoist is the place for you.

Join our team and be part of a people-first culture that values collaboration, innovation, and professional growth.

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!

  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!

title: Cloud Systems Engineer/DevOps
description:
About the Product

For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.


Role Overview

We are seeking an expert-level, highly skilled Cloud Systems Engineer (DevOps) to serve as a GCP Specialist and technical builder for our Google Cloud ecosystem. This role requires more than administration; you must be capable of building architectural change, adjusting systems, and driving modernization efforts. You will be responsible for the end-to-end management of our GCP infrastructure, from complex networking to proactive cost optimization and resource scaling. A key responsibility is leading and running large-scale cloud migration projects, specifically from AWS to GCP.


The ideal candidate ensures our Compute Engine environment is lean, fast, and resilient while maintaining secure connectivity using both native and third-party VPN solutions.

The role’s primary focus demands deep GCP expertise, but candidates must also possess significant experience with AWS for successful migration

strategy.


Key Responsibilities

  • Infrastructure & Networking: Configure and maintain robust networking architectures, including Cloud DNS and Cloud NAT.
  • Linux System Administration: Manage and maintain the operating system environment on Compute Engine instances, including patching, configuration management, user account management, and troubleshooting core system issues.
  • VPN Management: Build and manage secure tunnels using Cloud VPN , pfSense virtual appliances, and CloudConnexa (OpenVPN) for flexible remote access.
  • Performance Monitoring: Utilize Google Cloud Operations Suite to monitor Compute Engine health. Identify bottlenecks and tune instances for peak performance.
  • Resource Management: Oversee persistent disks, snapshots, and storage buckets. Ensure high availability while purging unused resources to maintain environment hygiene.
  • Cost Optimization: Actively monitor billing dashboards, implement committed use discounts (CUDs), and right-size underutilized instances to maintain a lean budget.
  • Database Oversight: Provide support for PostgreSQL and Oracle environments, ensuring seamless integration and performance within the GCP ecosystem.
  • Security & Compliance : Enforce IAM roles and security best practices to protect the project perimeter


Required Qualifications

  • Certification: Active Google Cloud Professional DevOps Engineer certification.
  • Containerization Mastery: Strong expertise with Docker for containerizing applications, managing images, and troubleshooting container runtimes.
  • Scripting Mastery: High proficiency in Python or Bash for automating routine infrastructure tasks, reporting, and task scheduling.
  • Networking Expertise: Hands-on experience managing network routing, firewall rules, and site-to-site VPNs using pfSense and CloudConnexa.
  • Cloud Migration & Project Leadership: Proven experience leading and running application and data migrations from AWS to GCP. This includes the capability to own the end-to-end migration project life cycle and drive solutions.
  • Compute Engine Mastery: Deep understanding of VM lifecycles, custom machine types, and auto-scaling.
  • English Proficiency: Advanced English level (B2–C1 or higher)


Nice-to-Have

  • PostgreSQL Expertise: Strong hands-on experience with configuration, optimization, and query tuning.
  • Oracle Expertise: Experience managing or migrating Oracle database environments.
  • Data & Analytics: Familiarity with BigQuery.


We offer

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule).
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Fully remote.


As this is an English-speaking role, we kindly ask that all applications be submitted with a CV in English.

title: Senior Estimator
description:
Company Overview:

Our ingenuity fuels daily life. Together, we’ve forged some of the most trusted partnerships across the energy value chain to make what was once just an idea a reality: laying subsea infrastructure thousands of feet below sea level, installing platforms hundreds of miles from shore, using our expertise to design and build offshore wind infrastructure, and reshaping the onshore landscape to deliver the energy products the world needs safely and sustainably.


For more than 100 years, we've been making the impossible possible. Today, we're driving the energy transition with more than 30,000 of the brightest minds across 54 countries.


Job Overview:

The Senior Estimator uses best practices and knowledge of internal or external issues to improve the estimating discipline within McDermott. They will act as a resource for colleagues with less experience and share their conceptual and practical expertise related to the estimating discipline. The Senior Estimator solves complex problems and uses their discipline-specific knowledge to improve their products or services. The Senior Estimator impacts a range of customer, operational, project, or service activities with the estimating team and other related teams and ensures that they are working within the appropriate guidelines and policies.


Job Responsibility:

  • Review, query, and understand the scope of work in order to prepare a proper estimate and direct attention to those areas that appear inconsistent or contain a high-risk element .
  • Support the PMT team to generate the Marine/Offshore Estimate for the Preliminary stage to ensure Bid No Bid.
  • Review the Project Plan along with the project planner and prepare subcontract scope packages for any work that is required to be subcontracted.
  • Gather information and input from functions with support from the Project Manager.
  • Consult with Subject Matter Expert (SME) to discuss Estimates and resolve issues.
  • Generate estimates with available Benchmark data and from experience prior to receiving the inputs from functions and evaluate the estimates received from functions against the internal estimate
  • Liaise with Project Team members plus all functional departments based on the specific functions allotted for a project, subcontractors and vendors, and Customer; including Procurement, Fabrication, Marine, Quality, HSES, Completions, and Welding Technology
  • Provide input to the Project Estimators, along with Basis of Estimate and Bench Markers
  • Give regular updates to the department manager/PMT /immediate supervisor and highlight any concerns about anything that might potentially jeopardize submitting a competitive proposal.
  • Analyze the cost components that are critical/crucial and seek quotes for applicable items.
  • Participate in Bid review meetings, estimate evaluation meetings, Risk assessment meetings, as well as any additional bid-related meetings, as required.
  • Prepare a comprehensive Basis of Estimate (BOE).
  • Review and identify contract price form.
  • Understand and clarify unit rate and lump sum breakdowns.
  • Accurately manage all the Previous Tender information and Treat it with Confidentiality
  • Utilize support from the benchmarking team (SMEs) by analyzing information on the costs from other similar projects and preparing the relevant benchmark report.
  • Attend and participate in Bid review meetings, estimate evaluation meetings, Risk assessment meetings, etc., as necessary for the Project/Department/Tender
  • Participate in HAZAN, HAZID, HAZOP, and other safety /operability/ reliability studies and workshops, as necessary for Project/Tender
  • Ensure any Risk or Opportunity highlighted is Duly captured for the Management review and approval.
  • Post Tender submission provide input for the clarification.
  • Support bid handover process ensuring proper transfer of pricing basis and critical assumptions to project team.
  • Manage own time to meet objectives; forecast and plan resource requirements.
  • Incorporate project planner input to develop the cost.
  • Assure that the estimate is:
  • Completed promptly
  • Cognizant of the Bid ‘Win Strategy’
  • Aligned with planned schedeule
  • All the Risk and Opportunities highlighted.
  • With Due Basis of Estimate
  • Accurate, free of errors, omission, or hidden contingency
  • In line with the agreed execution plan
  • Evaluate and recommend ways to be more cost-effective or profitable


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering or related technical discipline preferred. Equivalent experience will be considered.
  • Five plus (5+) years of experience in a large Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) company (preferably in Offshore/Marine Operations, and offshore estimation, ).
  • Subsea/SURF experience with Minimum 3–5 years of direct experience in subsea/SURF construction estimation, including deepwater pipeline installation, flexible/umbilical lay, subsea structure installation, and marine spread costs.
  • Experience with DSV, PLSV, and/or Heavy Construction Vessel (HCV) spread rate estimation strongly preferred.
  • Cost estimation experience, preferably in the Oil & Gas industry
  • Willingness to work overtime as necessary to meet deadlines
  • Intermediate level in Microsoft Office systems, e.g., Excel, Word, Outlook, PowerPoint, Project
  • Accurately evaluate detailed specifications that are crucial to a cost estimator’s success
  • Must pay attention to minute details because such details may impact a product’s overall cost

Must plan their work and work efficiently and accurately.

description:

Nice to Have

  • Experience acting as a proxy or delegate for the Product Owner.
  • Experience supporting cross‑functional or distributed Agile teams.

title: Data Scientist - Sênior (Motor de Busca)
description:
No Grupo SBF, reunimos duas grandes forças do esporte no Brasil: a Centauro, maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina, e a Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no país.


Queremos ser referência em esporte no Brasil e construir um futuro em que cada experiência com o esporte inspire, motive e transforme.


E aí, que tal vestir essa camisa com a gente?


Buscamos uma pessoa Cientista de Dados para atuar na squad de Busca, com foco em Busca Semântica, relevância e ranking. Essa posição tem papel estratégico na evolução da experiência de busca, atuando desde a definição de hipóteses até a implementação, experimentação e mensuração de impacto, com forte interface com Produto, Engenharia e Negócio.


Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver e evoluir soluções de Busca Semântica utilizando Elasticsearch, indo além da busca lexical tradicional.
  • Atuar na definição e otimização de: Estrutura de índices e mappings Estratégias de ranking híbrido (lexical + semântico) Queries semânticas (ex: embeddings, similarity search, boosting contextual)
  • Trabalhar com vetorização de conteúdo (produtos, termos de busca, atributos) para melhoria de relevância.
  • Avaliar e evoluir métricas de qualidade de busca. Conduzir testes A/B e experimentos controlados para validar impacto das melhorias semânticas. Traduzir problemas de negócio e experiência do usuário em soluções analíticas e modelos de dados.
  • Atuar em parceria com Engenharia e Produto na definição do roadmap técnico de busca. Garantir boas práticas de ciência de dados: versionamento, documentação, reprodutibilidade e monitoramento.
  • Apoiar tecnicamente outros cientistas de dados do time, elevando o nível das discussões técnicas.


Requisitos necessários

  • Formação superior completa em Ciência da Computação, Estatística, Matemática ou áreas afins. Experiência comprovada de 5 a 7 anos em projetos de ciência de dados.
  • Experiência prática com Busca Semântica em Elasticsearch
  • Experiência com Information Retrieval (IR) e conceitos de relevância.
  • Conhecimento em NLP aplicado à busca (ex: embeddings, similaridade textual).
  • Experiência com modelos de ranking ou learning to rank.
  • Domínio de SQL para análise de grandes volumes de dados.
  • Proficiência em Python para análise de dados, experimentação e modelagem.
  • Vivência com experimentação e testes A/B em ambientes de produto.
  • Capacidade de comunicação clara com públicos técnicos e não técnicos.
  • Experiência em produtos digitais com alto volume de dados. Noções de MLOps.
  • Sólida vivência em versionamento de código (Git), com prática de code review, padrões de branches e integração contínua.


Diferenciais

  • Vivência com BigQuery ou data lakes.
  • Experiência prévia em e-commerce, marketplace ou plataformas de discovery.
  • Experiência em observabilidade e monitoramento da qualidade da busca.
  • Conhecimento em técnicas de visualização de dados e storytelling.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de business intelligence, como Power BI.


Perfil esperado

  • Forte mentalidade de produto e experiência do usuário.
  • Perfil analítico, curioso e orientado a impacto.
  • Autonomia para conduzir iniciativas complexas de ponta a ponta.
  • Capacidade de influenciar decisões técnicas e de produto com dados.
  • Boa colaboração em times multidisciplinares.

We are looking for a BI Analyst to own and improve business reporting across fraud, chargebacks, alerts, merchant performance, and operations. This role is focused on dashboards, KPI tracking, reporting consistency, metric definitions, and turning business questions into clear, actionable insights.

You will work closely with leadership, operations, product, and engineering to make data easier to understand, easier to trust, and more useful in day-to-day decision-making.


Responsibilities

  • Own dashboards, recurring reports, and KPI tracking across core business areas
  • Build and maintain reporting that gives teams clear visibility into fraud, chargebacks, disputes, alerts, and operational performance
  • Write and optimize SQL for reporting, analysis, and data validation
  • Define, document, and improve business metrics so teams are working from consistent numbers
  • Analyze trends, anomalies, and performance changes across key datasets
  • Partner with stakeholders to translate business questions into practical reporting and analysis
  • Improve the usability, accuracy, and trustworthiness of existing reports and dashboards
  • Identify reporting gaps, data inconsistencies, and metric definition issues
  • Create clear visualizations and present findings in a business-friendly way
  • Support self-service reporting and help teams use data more effectively


Requirements

  • Strong SQL skills
  • Experience building and maintaining dashboards and recurring business reporting
  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to translate ambiguous business questions into clear metrics, reporting, and analysis
  • Experience working with production data and validating reporting accuracy
  • Strong communication skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Experience defining and maintaining KPIs or business metrics
  • Comfortable working in a remote environment
  • Able to pass a background check


Preferred

  • Experience with fraud, payments, chargebacks, disputes, risk, or other operational data
  • Experience with BI and visualization tools
  • Experience working with large datasets in a business reporting environment
  • Experience with AWS-based data environments
  • Basic Python skills for ad hoc analysis or validation
  • Experience with ClickHouse or similar analytical databases
  • Familiarity with data warehouse or reporting-layer concepts

A equipe de Analytics de BMP (Business Model and Pricing) está buscando um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados experiente para apoiar a gestão de desempenho do negócio e a tomada de decisões estratégicas por meio de infraestrutura de dados escalável e soluções de engenharia. A equipe trabalha em estreita colaboração com liderança, finanças, operações e stakeholders do negócio para viabilizar acesso confiável a dados de alta qualidade, apoiar análises avançadas e impulsionar ações orientadas por dados em toda a organização.

O(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados terá um papel crítico no desenho, construção e manutenção de pipelines de dados robustos, modelos de dados e ativos fundamentais que suportam analytics, relatórios e capacidades emergentes de IA/ML. Essa função exige forte rigor em engenharia, profundo entendimento de sistemas de dados e capacidade de colaborar entre equipes técnicas e de negócio.

O(a) candidato(a) ideal possui um histórico comprovado na construção de soluções de dados escaláveis em ambientes dinâmicos e multifuncionais, e sente-se confortável equilibrando trabalho em plataformas de dados fundamentais com iniciativas em evolução de analytics e IA.


O que você fará

Você possui uma forte mentalidade de engenharia e resolução de problemas. Converte necessidades de negócio e analíticas em soluções e arquiteturas de dados escaláveis e confiáveis.

Projeta, constrói e mantém pipelines e modelos de dados escaláveis que suportam monitoramento de desempenho do negócio, analytics e relatórios, além de contribuir para o desenvolvimento da Base de Dados BMP em ambientes Hive, Snowflake e data lakes.

Apoia o desenvolvimento de produtos e aplicações de dados, incluindo contribuição em pipelines baseados em Streamlit e no desenvolvimento de capacidades de chatbot para melhorar o acesso e a interação com dados.

Colabora de perto com equipes de analytics, ciência de dados e áreas de negócio para garantir disponibilidade, qualidade e usabilidade dos dados para dashboards, relatórios e análises avançadas.

Viabiliza e apoia o desenvolvimento de analytics avançado, machine learning e capacidades de IA, garantindo que a infraestrutura, pipelines e ambientes necessários estejam disponíveis para o desenvolvimento e implantação de modelos.

Contribui para o design e evolução do ecossistema de dados e ML, ajudando a estabelecer infraestrutura, processos e fundamentos necessários para escalar iniciativas de IA/ML na organização.


Qualificações Mínimas

• Mestrado em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Dados, Engenharia ou área quantitativa relacionada.

• Mais de 5 anos de experiência em engenharia de dados, desenvolvimento de plataformas de dados ou funções relacionadas.

• Forte experiência com SQL e pelo menos uma linguagem de programação (Python ou equivalente).

• Familiaridade com frameworks de big data e processamento distribuído (ex.: Spark / PySpark).

• Experiência na construção e manutenção de pipelines de dados e trabalho com arquiteturas modernas de dados.

• Experiência com ferramentas de orquestração (ex.: Airflow) e automação de pipelines.

• Experiência com plataformas de dados em nuvem (ex.: AWS) e soluções de data warehouse (ex.: Snowflake).

• Sólido entendimento de modelagem de dados, qualidade de dados e governança de dados.

• Experiência com sistemas de controle de versão (Git) e fluxos colaborativos de desenvolvimento.

• Fortes habilidades de resolução de problemas e capacidade de trabalhar com requisitos ambíguos.

• Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e capacidade de colaborar com stakeholders técnicos e não técnicos.

• Inglês fluente.


Qualificações Desejáveis

• Experiência com arquiteturas de data lake e ambientes de dados híbridos.

• Experiência com suporte a pipelines e infraestrutura de machine learning.

• Experiência com aplicações de dados (ex.: Streamlit) e interfaces conversacionais (chatbots).

• Experiência com ferramentas e práticas de desenvolvimento assistido por IA.

• Experiência contribuindo para documentação e plataformas de compartilhamento de conhecimento (ex.: Confluence).

• Experiência em organizações globais com estrutura matricial.

title: Agentic Developer

You will play a key role in building and enhancing core product capabilities while ensuring reliability, scalability, and long-term maintainability.

In this context, agentic development refers to the structured use of AI

lifecycle. This includes using agents to assist with design, implementation,

testing, debugging, and code quality while maintaining full ownership of

correctness and production readiness.

You will work closely with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality solutions, improve system performance, and elevate engineering standards. title: Professor de inglês
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?


  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?


  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Account Manager
description:
As an Account Manager for Brazil , you'll join our passionate and supportive team characterised by our ambition and team spirit. You'll have the freedom to work independently while fostering strong collaboration with our content and product departments.


You'll be responsible for driving the entire sales and success cycle in the iGaming market, from initial engagement to maximizing long-term results. Managing key client relationships, driving sales growth, and ensuring customer satisfaction within these specific regions. This role requires a proactive approach to identifying opportunities, understanding client needs, and delivering tailored solutions that drive mutual success.


Specifically, your role will involve:


  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with key clients, including sports betting operators, casinos, online gaming platforms, and other relevant stakeholders.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for key client accounts, managing all aspects of the client relationship and serving as their trusted advisor.
  • Understand clients' business objectives, market trends, and regulatory requirements specific to the English speaking markets to effectively position our gambling products and services.
  • Collaborate with internal sales, marketing, and product development teams to customize solutions and address client needs within these regions.
  • Proactively identify opportunities for upselling additional products/services and expanding client accounts.
  • Prepare and deliver compelling sales presentations, proposals, and business cases to key clients within these regions.
  • Monitor and analyze sales performance, market trends, and competitor activities to identify opportunities for growth and optimization within key accounts.
  • Attend industry events, conferences, and trade shows worldwide to network with key clients and stay informed about industry insights and developments.
  • Provide timely and accurate reports on key account performance, sales activity, and revenue forecasts within these regions to management.
  • Stay up-to-date on gambling regulations, compliance standards, and responsible gaming practices to ensure adherence and mitigate risks.


The ideal profile


We're on the lookout for someone who not only shares our values and ambitions but also envisions growing alongside MoveUp Media. As a dedicated team player, you embody fair play, transparency, agility, and an unstoppable drive. You're the perfect fit for our team if you:


  • Have outstanding written and verbal communication skills in Brazilian Portuguese and English.
  • Understand gambling products, platforms, and regulations in specific regions.
  • Drive change and support accounts in the iGaming industry with your sales skills.
  • Be ambitious, adaptable, and thrive in fast-paced environments.
  • Focus on exceeding sales targets and driving revenue growth.
  • Bring experience in iGaming strategy, sales, or affiliate management.
  • Excel in building and maintaining strong relationships with partners.
  • Possess excellent communication and negotiation skills.
  • Show active listening, resilience, and persistence.
  • Demonstrate strong problem-solving abilities and effective task coordination.
  • Excel in time management, organization, and planning.
  • Manage multiple accounts and tasks simultaneously.
  • Use analytical skills and a data-driven mindset for decision-making.
  • Thrive in teamwork and adapt well to evolving environments.
  • Be open to occasional travel for client meetings and industry events.


Feeling up to the task of managing the main challenges of the role, even without meeting all criteria? We're eager to hear from you! We know not all great candidates will match 100% of the above.


Next steps in the process ✅


  • First Interview: A conversation with your future manager to ensure you meet the role’s requirements.
  • Second Interview: A chat with HR to understand you better and ensure a cultural fit with MoveUp Media.
  • Final Step: A proposition for us to start working together!


What’s in it for you


  • Remote Work Environment: Enjoy the flexibility of working remotely full-time.
  • Flexible Schedule: We measure results , not hours, and offer paid time off.
  • Development Opportunities: As a rapidly growing startup, we offer numerous possibilities for career advancement and support your career path.
  • Team Gatherings: Annual team get-togethers to connect, work, and have fun . We strive to find enjoyable spots for everyone.
  • Wellness Fund: €1,000 per year dedicated to your professional development, sports, or cultural events of your choice.


MoveUp Media
